instruction: Candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpet, white walls, and a printer in the background. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, reaching his left hand to touch the right arm of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the left side of the frame, facing right and looking at him. The room is brightly lit by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R1 reaches his left hand to touch R2's right arm
R2 is the person receiving the arm touch from R1
R1 stands facing R2 while making the contact
R2 stands facing and looking at R1 during the contact
